_note: 301 redirects from old Hostinger-Horizons URLs to the new slugs (CLAUDE.md §7). GitHub Pages has no server-side redirects, so Astro renders a static redirect page per exact entry (list each path once, without the trailing slash). Wildcard entries (`from` ending in /*) cannot be static pages: they are handled by dist/404.html, which GitHub Pages serves for every unknown path and which sends the visitor to `to` (client-side). Real 301s and www→apex happen at DNS switch (phase 4). Decision 9 Oct 2026: old /branches/<uuid> pages have no mapping → everything under /branches/ goes to the home page; the 404 page also lists both branches. 4 Nov 2026 (Ahmed's decisions on docs/prelaunch-audit.md §4): every old Horizons URL maps to its exact new page (the 2 branch and 10 room IDs, the Umrah offer → /partners/groups-umrah/), the rest to the closest page; `via: page` entries are conditional and rendered by src/pages/[legacy].astro (to = when that page is built, else = otherwise); wildcard /offers/*, /blog/*, /admin/* through 404.html; an absolute https target is the dashboard's sign-in.
www_to_apex: 301 at Hostinger DNS / GitHub Pages custom domain — not part of the static build

redirects._why: the dining page while a venue is active, else the Airport Road café section (src/pages/[legacy].astro decides at build time)
only while /gallery/ is not built (fewer than 6 published photos): src/pages/404.astro sends it home; once the gallery exists the old path is the new page
